title: Cap. III Resp. Rat. 2 close: Semipelagian charge — Augustine election yields faith/sanctity/perseverance
pass_a_gloss: Finally, in this argument of his Vasquez crosses into the camp of the Semipelagians, and deserts Augustine, who everywhere teaches that men are not elected to eternal life from foresight of faith or of good works, but that rather all our good works arise from this, that we were predestined to eternal life. Hence faith: They are not elected because they believed, but they are elected that they may believe, De praedestinatione sanctorum book 1 chapter 17. Hence holiness: It is certain and manifest that therefore we are to be holy, because God elected us, predestining that through grace we should be such: ibid. chapter 18. Hence perseverance: To the saints predestined by grace into the kingdom of God, perseverance itself is given, De correptione et gratia chapter 12. After election, therefore, all our goods are foreseen, because they proceed from election itself.
pass_b_english: Finally, in this argument Vasquez crosses into the Semipelagian camp and leaves Augustine, who everywhere teaches men are not elected to eternal life from foresight of faith or good works — rather all our good works arise because we were predestined to eternal life. Faith: not elected because they believed, but elected that they may believe (De praed. sanct. 1.17). Holiness: certain and plain we will be holy because God elected us, predestining that by grace we should be such (ibid. 18). Perseverance: to saints predestined by grace into God's kingdom, perseverance itself is given (De corr. et grat. 12). So after election all our goods are foreseen, because they spring from election itself.
source_text: Postremo, in hoc suo argumento Vasques transit in castra Semipelagianorum, & Augustinum deserit, qui passim docet, non eligi homines ad vitam aeternam ex praescientia fidei aut bonorum operum, sed inde potius oriri omnia nostra bona opera, quod fuimus praedestinati ad vitam aeternam. Hinc fides: Non eliguntur quia crediderunt, sed eliguntur ut credant, De Praedest. sanct. lib. 1. cap. 17. Hinc sanctitas: Certum & manifestum est, ideo nos sanctos futuros, quia elegit nos Deus, praedestinans ut per gratiam tales essemus: ibid. cap. 18. Hinc perseverantia: Sanctis in regnum Dei per gratiam praedestinatis, donatur ipsa perseverantia, De corr. & gratia, cap. 12. Post electionem igitur omnia nostra bona praevidentur, quia ab electione ipsa proficiscuntur.
